excerpts.text: - [x] Number: required checked owner holds 24 parsing, formatting and prototype declarations; 25 scoped emission boundaries and typed dependency inputs replace flat metadata. Merged in #1680 after CI gates and exact-head review completed. The external review (CodeRabbit) completed exact-head review of all 27 changed files at 835c60697747b5130781d343ef77aa2c78214c6b (run fabeddef-a36c-456b-bc24-346ec34164e0), without reporting unavailable clone-backed analysis. It raised two Number compatibility findings: global predicate value-form coercion and explicit radix-16 prefix parsing. Both were verified as pre-existing with normalized source comparisons to current main and four successful re-executions of saved baseline/current assemblies; they were documented and their threads resolved as outside this behavior-preserving ownership refactor. The defects are not fixed or claimed conformant. The reviewer subsequently accepted both baseline explanations and explicitly withdrew both findings; the original automated moderate-risk summary predates those replies. Supplemental immutable-head/local source audits and fresh ownership/output verification passed. A subsequent two-file incremental review of the Windows cleanup correction completed at the preceding head 9bb81eba381cfa3821c4c257caab2960eb549701 (run a2e07d89-2aaa-4cf7-aed5-58308a9b9448), with no new actionable findings and no stated clone-backed analysis limitation. Its low-risk summary still mentions the two preserved compatibility defects; their evidence-backed reviewer withdrawals remain applicable. The final correction also has its own local source review and red/green regression evidence. CI remains an independent merge gate. The final one-file CI-budget review completed at f39f2420f799a94f6e5747b43678bb6396d862d0 (run 991e4a62-ffdb-4885-abb0-233a95ca0bd2), with no new actionable comments or stated clone-backed analysis limitation. Its moderate-risk summary repeats the same two previously withdrawn compatibility findings; the complete product/test trees are identical to the preceding reviewed head, and the linked baseline evidence and explicit withdrawals still apply. No claim is made that those existing defects are fixed. CI remains a separate required gate. Original broad verification passed 740 distinct cases with 77 new cases (56 owner and 21 isolated), and fresh verification after preceding merges passed 181 focused cases, all 24 regenerated IL-verified comparisons preserving 24,502 method bodies/exception regions, 22 standalone executions and two hosted outputs. Release build and quality gates passed. Two newly inherited wrapper fixture references were adapted to the Number owner; compiler source remained unchanged. A subsequent Windows CI failure exposed a pre-existing child-process shutdown E_HANDLE race. A narrow cleanup catch and two regression/control cases fix that path; the invalid-handle case failed before the correction. Fresh supplemental verification covers 191 distinct passing cases, including two named-pipe IPC cases rechecked with normal Windows permissions after sandbox connection failures, plus another 24 regenerated IL/output comparisons and quality gates. A later one-file CI correction raises the aggregate core-suite step budget from 15 to 20 minutes under the existing 30-minute job limit after both platforms timed out while completing tests. Commands, filters, individual deadlines, 100,000 generator iterations and allocation/performance checks remain unchanged. All ten generator-class cases passed locally; the unchanged 100,000-iteration test subsequently passed in both full CI jobs under its original deadline. Final CI completed 21,450 core cases per platform (21,449 passes and one Windows-only-test skip on Linux; 21,447 passes and three existing platform skips on Windows), plus 129 GUI passes per platform, with zero failures. Both fork IPC modes passed, the native invalid-handle regression passed on Windows, and all required workflow gates passed. The prior generator timeout was not reproduced and no generator fix is claimed. Workflow-policy and change-scope checks passed. Compiler/emitter and complete test source remain unchanged by that correction. Early declaration order, cached formatting delegate, UInt64 parsing/scaling and BigInteger fallback, prototype descriptors/identity, native signatures and optimization flags are preserved. General-radix parsing and global-predicate alias baseline behavior remains unchanged. General numeric coercion and all broader residual ownership/audit work remain required.
